description: Look up a MITRE ATT&CK technique by exact ID or keyword. Results include tactics, platforms, description, detection data, public procedure examples, mitigations, related sub-techniques, and dataset version.

include_subtechniques.description: Include sub-techniques in the result. Set to false when only the parent technique summary is needed.

query.description: ATT&CK technique ID (e.g., "T1190", "T1059.001") or keyword describing the technique (e.g., "sql injection", "pass the hash", "web shell upload"). ID lookup is exact; keyword lookup returns the best match plus related techniques.

name: pentest_lookup_technique

authorized_use_reminder.description: Reminder that technique data is for authorized testing and research only. Rendered first.

detection.description: ATT&CK detection context for the technique.

data_sources.description: ATT&CK data sources relevant to detection.

summary.description: Overview of how defenders detect this technique.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `no_match`: No technique matched the query. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

items.description: A recommended ATT&CK mitigation with its ID, name, and effect description.

description.description: How this mitigation reduces the technique's effectiveness.

procedure_examples.description: Real-world usage examples from ATT&CK public reporting.

items.description: A real-world usage example from ATT&CK public reporting.

description.description: How the group or software used this technique, from public ATT&CK reporting.

group_or_software.description: Threat group name or malware name that used this technique.

sub_techniques.description: Sub-techniques of this parent technique. Empty when querying a sub-technique itself, or when include_subtechniques is false.

items.description: A sub-technique ID, name, and brief description.

description.description: Brief description of the sub-technique (first 200 chars).

tactics.description: ATT&CK tactics this technique belongs to (e.g., "Initial Access", "Execution").

title: Pentest Lookup Technique
